summary: Created appworker on node1 and configured all fresh login sessions with soft and hard limits of 8,192 open files and 256 processes. Verified the settings before and after a successful node restart.
actions_performed: Added /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with root ownership and mode 0644.
Verified effective limits in fresh PAM-backed login sessions.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified the account, home directory, configuration, effective limits, and healthy system state after restart.

evidence.requirement: Create the appworker account on node1
evidence.summary: Account exists as UID/GID 1000 with /home/appworker and /bin/bash; it persisted across restart.

evidence.requirement: Limit login sessions to 8,192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: Persistent soft and hard nofile values are 8192 and nproc values are 256; fresh login sessions reported those exact effective limits before and after restart.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 3fad4432-1dea-40c8-b4f1-970d19eb5f34; reboot was acknowledged; the recovered node reported changed boot ID 1603cbad-a8df-4d0b-8414-6bf39ea48b32, system state running, and intact account and limits.
